description: This file defines the CompareImagesForm class, a GUI component that provides functionality to compare images and associated tables in ROM files within a software project related to ECU tuning and reflashing. It allows users to select two images (ROMs), compare their tables, and display differences visually and in a list.

classes.name: CompareImagesForm
classes.description: A JFrame-based GUI class for comparing images and tables within ROM files. It provides dropdowns for selecting ROM images, a compare button, and a list to show differences. It manages table comparison logic and UI rendering for comparison results.

classes.name: ComboBoxRenderer
classes.description: A custom renderer for JComboBox items to display ROM file names.

classes.name: ChangeListCellRenderer
classes.description: A custom list cell renderer to display comparison results with color coding based on the type of change (equal, different, missing).

classes.name: ListItem
classes.description: A simple class representing a list item with a type indicator and value, used for rendering comparison results in the list.

methods.name: CompareImagesForm
methods.description: Constructor initializing the GUI components, populating ROM selection dropdowns, and setting up event listeners.

methods.name: populateComboBoxes
methods.description: Populates the image selection combo boxes with the list of available ROMs.

methods.name: compareTables
methods.description: Performs comparison of tables between two ROMs and updates the UI with the results, including counts of equal, different, and missing tables.

methods.name: findAndShowTable
methods.description: Searches for a specific table in a ROM's table nodes and displays it for editing/viewing if found.

methods.name: actionPerformed
methods.description: Handles UI actions, specifically performing table comparison when the compare button is clicked.
